checks.detail: AST scan: the spec generator uses none of the forbidden holdout loader symbols, imports no validation/holdout module and declares no validation/holdout data path

the #419 baseline, the #388 TRAIN support matrix and the #388 decision all declare split_consumed=TRAIN with validation_consumed=false and test_consumed=false; the tripwire aborts on any other declaration

the generator parses no hand-history archive and no decision JSONL; it consumes content-addressed evidence artifacts plus structural source files only. The build ran with a filesystem tripwire: any open under training/datasets/ or of a .zip/.jsonl file aborts the build, and the observed open set is exactly the declared inputs plus the pinned #388 bundle.
#388 artifacts are byte-verified against their ARTIFACTS.json content addresses and the #419 baseline is bound by canonical payload hash before the spec is serialized

rare_hand_class_inheritance.rare_hand_class_definition: hand class with fewer than 10 observations at the requested key
rare_hand_class_inheritance.reveal_policy: reveals are descriptive labels of the observed sample only; they never enter the key, the features, the support counts or the shrinkage
rare_hand_class_inheritance.rule: a rare hand class inherits from the hand-class marginal of its OWN requested key, then from the declared hierarchical levels of that same key; never from another key

EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG.condition: the requested fine key meets both 20/20 thresholds and the reported estimate uses pooling.level == L0_EXACT_KEY
EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG.interpretation: exact empirical support for this exact context

EXACT_HIERARCHICAL_ESTIMATE.condition: the requested fine key is below threshold but a declared parent level meets both 20/20 thresholds; pooling.level and pooling.source_key are reported
EXACT_HIERARCHICAL_ESTIMATE.interpretation: an estimate for the exact requested context whose parameters were shrunk toward a declared parent; it is never an exact-support claim
EXACT_HIERARCHICAL_ESTIMATE.support_source: requested_key only (support counts stay exact and possibly zero)

EXACT_UNRESOLVED.condition: no level meets both thresholds, or the raise sizing for the branch is unresolved, or the requested key violates the support isolation rule
EXACT_UNRESOLVED.interpretation: no answer is emitted; the context and its descendants stay unresolved

credited independence: equal to distinct_hands, because multiple decisions inside one hand are correlated and must not inflate the sample

FOLD/CALL/RAISE/JAM (+CHECK when legal), summing to 1 over legal actions

corollaries: a coarse provider key may seed a prior but may not certify support for a finer requested key
a finer key never borrows observations from its siblings

evidence.meaning: a coarse lookup would be supported by rows of at least two distinct requested keys, which this rule forbids

support_isolation_rule.fail_closed: a runtime answer whose support source key differs from the requested key must raise, never silently emit; it is never downgraded into an exact claim
support_isolation_rule.pooling_effect: pooling may change the prior/posterior of the estimate, never the support counts of the requested key
support_isolation_rule.statement: A key A may never be declared supported by observations of a different key B. Support quantities (observations, distinct hands, effective sample size) are computed exclusively from rows whose hierarchical_exact_key equals A.
